headline: Go Digit General Insurance: SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) Disclosure Filed
sum: Go Digit General Insurance disclosed a substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), triggering mandatory public disclosure of the acquirer's shareholding and offer intent, though the acquirer's identity and consideration remain to be corroborated.
detail: Go Digit General Insurance Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory once a person or group acquires or commits to acquire shares that, together with shares already held, will result in 5% or more of the company's capital or voting rights, or where a person makes an open offer. The disclosure must include the acquirer's identity, the acquisition details, source of funds, and any offer-related plans.
